decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core dental software business, supported by the firm’s own R&D and explicit positioning as a new product line, it fits existing knowledge well and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

The education institute builds on the firm’s training content, customer relationships, and practitioner knowledge, so management can absorb feedback and refine the offering, though it is somewhat more service-like than the software core.

A remote support tool is highly complementary to the firm’s established software, support, and integration capabilities, making it easy to learn from use and commercially apply within the existing customer base.
